z-m-28-03.topic: Kurongedza kana pane makadhi emavara akafanana akasanganiswa: kuenzanisa mhinduro nhatu dzakasiyana
z-m-28-03.goal: Ongorora kururama kwemhinduro dzakasiyana dzehuwandu hwokurongedza kana zvinhu zvinoratidzika zvakafanana zvakasanganiswa, uye utsvage chikonzero chenhanho dzinowanza kana kuparadzanisa.
z-m-28-03.material:
Pane makadhi emavara 6. 3 ndi A, 2 ndi N, uye 1 ndi B, uye makadhi ane vara rimwe chete anoratidzika zvakafanana zvizere, saka haagoni kusiyaniswa. Vanhu vatatu vakagadzirisa zvakasiyana huwandu hwokurongedza kwakasiyana kwamavara (muenzaniso: BANANA, ABNANA) kunogona kugadzirwa nokuisa makadhi 6 mumutsetse.
Seoha: Pane marudzi 3 amavara, saka nzira yokurongedza zvinhu 3 i 3×2×1=6 nzira.
Harin: Kana tikatora ose 6 sezvakasiyana, ndi nzira 720. Kuchinjana mavara akafanana kunopa kurongedza kumwe chete, saka paradzanisa nokurongeka 6 kwamakadhi 3 e A nokurongeka 2 kwamakadhi 2 e N: 720÷12=60 nzira.
Junho: Pane nzira 20 dzokusarudza nzvimbo 3 kubva pa 6 dze A. Pakati penzvimbo 3 dzasara, pane nzira 3 dzokusarudza nzvimbo 2 dze N. B inoenda munzvimbo yasara, saka 20×3=60 nzira.
z-m-28-03.thinking.0: Kuenzanisa mhinduro dzakati wandei kuti utonge kururama kwadzo
z-m-28-03.thinking.1: Kuongorora chikonzero chokuwanza kana kuparadzanisa kwega kwega mumitsetse yomugadzirisiro

z-m-28-03.s.s1.hint.1: Gadzika B pamberi, nyora uye uverenge zvakananga kurongedza kwevamwe A A A N N mumutsetse, uye uenzanise nekukosha kwakaverengwa nemhinduro imwe neimwe.
z-m-28-03.s.s1.r.a: Izvi zvakatsanangura 'makadhi haagoni kusiyaniswa' se 'rongedza marudzi amavara chete.' Unofanira kutarisa nokunyora kana chokwadi chokuti pane makadhi 3 e A na 2 e N chichiratidzwa mukurongedza.
z-m-28-03.s.s1.r.b: Mhinduro iyi inoverenga sokunge ose 6 akasiyana woobva waparadzanisa nehuwandu hunobva pakuchinjana kwakafanana. Yakaverenga kuti chinhu chimwe nechimwe chinodzokororwa kangani.
z-m-28-03.s.s1.r.c: Iyi inzira inosarudza nzvimbo kutanga woobva waisa mavara. Ikutonga kuti kumakadhi emavara akafanana, unongoda kusarudza nzvimbo, saka hakuna chikonzero chokuverenga kurongeka kwawo zvakasiyana.
z-m-28-03.s.s1.explain: Mhinduro yaHarin inoparadzanisa nokuti nzira 720 kana makadhi 6 akasiyaniswa dzakaverengwa 3!×2!=12 nguva kukurongedza kumwe chete kwega kwega, uye mhinduro yaJunho inosarudza kutanga nzvimbo dzinoenda mavara, saka mhinduro mbiri dzose dzinopa nzira 60 dzakafanana. Mhinduro yaSeoha haiverengi makadhi 6 ari kuiswa mumutsetse uye inorongedza marudzi amavara chete. Semuenzaniso, BANANA ne BNAANA hazvigoni kusiyaniswa nokurongeka kwemarudzi amavara oga.
z-m-28-03.s.s2.prompt: Minjae akawana, nenzira imwe chete, huwandu hwokurongedza kwakasiyana kwe 'makadhi 2 e A, makadhi 2 e B, kadhi 1 re C' mumutsetse. Mutsetse upi womugadzirisiro wakanganisa? Mitsetse inoverengwa kubva pa 1.

z-m-28-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kutanga pamutsetse 1, enzanisa kana chikonzero chimwe chete chakashandiswa pakati pamakadhi 2 e A namakadhi 2 e B.
z-m-28-03.s.s2.line.0: Kana makadhi 5 ose akasiyana, ndi 5×4×3×2×1=120 nzira.
z-m-28-03.s.s2.line.1: Kuchinjana makadhi e A kunopa kurongedza kumwe chete, saka paradzanisa nokurongeka 2 kwamakadhi 2 e A. 120÷2=60 nzira.
z-m-28-03.s.s2.line.2: Kuchinjana makadhi e B kunopawo kurongedza kumwe chete, asi panguva ino kurongeka 2 kwamakadhi 2 e B kwakawanzwa, zvichipa 60×2=120 nzira.
z-m-28-03.s.s2.line.3: Saka huwandu hwokurongedza kwakasiyana i nzira 120.
z-m-28-03.s.s2.explain: Mutsetse 3 wakanganisa. Kuchinjana makadhi e B akafanana kunopawo kurongedza kumwe chete, saka unofanira kuparadzanisa ne 2, sezvakangoita kuna A. 120÷2÷2=30 nzira. Kana makadhi akafanana akasanganiswa, huwandu hwokurongedza kwakasiyana hunofanira kuva hudiki pane nzira 120 kana makadhi ose akasiyana, uye mhedzisiro yaMinjae haina kudzikira pasi pe 120, izvo zvinoratidzawo kuti pane chinoshamisa.
z-m-28-03.s.s3.prompt: Pane kurongedza kwakasiyana kwakadini pamwe chete kwamakadhi 2 e A, makadhi 2 e B, namakadhi 2 e C mumutsetse?
z-m-28-03.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora kuti kurongedza kumwe chete kunodzokororwa kangani kumakadhi 2 e A, kumakadhi 2 e B, nokumakadhi 2 e C.
z-m-28-03.s.s3.hint.1: Tanga waverenga nzira dzokusarudza nzvimbo dzemakadhi maviri e A pakati penzvimbo 6, wobva waverenga nzira dzokusarudza nzvimbo dze B pakati penzvimbo dzasara, uye uenzanise.
z-m-28-03.s.s3.r.a: Uku kutonga kwakawana kukosha kana ose 6 akasiyana wobva waparadzanisa nokudzokororwa kwose kunobva pakadhi rudzi rwega rwega.
z-m-28-03.s.s3.r.b: Izvi zvakaparadzanisa nokurongeka kwamakadhi 2 e A chete. Unofanira kutarisa kana kuchinjana makadhi akafanana e B ne C kunopawo kurongedza kumwe chete.
z-m-28-03.s.s3.r.c: Uku ndiko kukosha kunobva pakurongedza marudzi amavara chete. Chokwadi chokuti pane 2 yekadhi rimwe nerimwe hachina kushandiswa mukurongedza.
z-m-28-03.s.s3.r.d: Ikukosha umo kuparadzanisa kwakaitwa kaviri uye rimwe rakasiiwa. Tarisa kana chikonzero chimwe chete chinoshanda kumarudzi ose matatu.
z-m-28-03.s.s3.explain: 720÷(2×2×2)=90. Uchishandisa nzira yokusarudza nzvimbo, C(6,2)×C(4,2)×C(2,2)=15×6×1=90 zvakare (verenga: chigadzirwa chenzira dzokusarudza nzvimbo 2 dze A pakati penzvimbo 6 nenzvimbo 2 dze B pakati pe 4 dzasara).

z-m-28-08.title: Nhamba yenzira dzekukwira masitepisi: kana mutsetse waonekwa, tinogona kuuvimba here?
z-m-28-08.topic: Nhamba yenzira dzekukwira sitepisi 1 kana 2 panguva (kuwana mutsetse munhamba nechikonzero chawo)
z-m-28-08.goal: Ona kuti pattern inoonekwa mumitengo mishoma yekutanga haina kugadzwa kuita imwe chete, tsvaga chikonzero che pattern kubva pachimiro uye urebese mitengo, uye utarise mutengo mumwechete nenzira yakasiyana.
z-m-28-08.material: Unogona kukwira nhanho 1 kana nhanho 2 panguva imwe. Kana pane nhanho n, regai a(n) ive nhamba yenzira dzakasiyana dzekukwira kubva pasi chaipo kusvika kumusoro chaipo (verenga se 'a of n'). Kana kurongeka kwemakwira kwakasiyana, i nzira yakasiyana. Semuenzaniso, nenhanho 3 pane nzira 3, 1-1-1, 1-2, ne 2-1, saka a(3)=3.
z-m-28-08.thinking.0: Kufungidzira pattern kubva padata chete uye kuziva miganhu yayo
z-m-28-08.thinking.1: Kutsvaga chikonzero che pattern kubva pachimiro
z-m-28-08.prereq.1: Chibvumirano chekuti kurongeka kwemakwira kwakasiyana i nzira yakasiyana, nekuwedzera natural numbers
z-m-28-08.s.s1.prompt: Nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rwuchiwedzerwa, fungidzira mutengo uye uugadzirise.
z-m-28-08.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti unogona kutaura ma pattern mangani nemitengo yaunoziva zvino.
z-m-28-08.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kana ruzivo rutsva rwuchidzikisa fungidziro kuita imwe chete, kana dzakati wandei dzichisara.
z-m-28-08.s.s1.st.0.after: Kubva pamitengo mitatu 1, 2, 3 bedzi, zvose 'inokwira neimwe nguva dzose' (4) ne 'pundutso yemitengo miviri yapfuura' (5) zvinogoneka. Panhanho iyi haigone kugadzwa kuita imwe chete.
z-m-28-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ndakaona 1, 2, 3 sezvichienderera nekukwira neimwe nguva dzose.
z-m-28-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ndakazviona sekuwanza mitengo miviri yapfuura. a(3)=3 haikodzeri mutemo uyu.
z-m-28-08.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ndakaona mitengo sekuwanzwa ne 2 nguva dzose. Izvi hazvikodzeri 1, 2, 3.
z-m-28-08.s.s1.st.1.after: Kubva ku 1, 2, 3, 5, zvose 'misiyano i 1, 1, 2, saka musiyano unotevera i 2' (7) ne 'pundutso yemitengo miviri yapfuura' (8) zvinoratidzika zvakajairika. Zvichiri zvakaoma kuva nechokwadi kubva panhamba bedzi.
z-m-28-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ndakaona mutemo wekuwedzera mitengo miviri yapfuura uchienderera.
z-m-28-08.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ndakaona mitengo sekuwanzwa ne 2 nguva dzose. Izvi hazvikodzeri 1, 2, 3, 5.
z-m-28-08.s.s1.st.2.info: Verenga chikonzero. Kukwira kwekupedzisira pamberi pekusvika kumusoro i nhanho 1 kana nhanho 2. Kana kukwira kwekupedzisira i nhanho 1, nzira dzekukwira kusvika kunhanho n−1 pamberi payo i a(n−1), uye kana i nhanho 2, nzira dzekukwira kusvika kunhanho n−2 i a(n−2). Zviitiko zviviri izvi hazvipindirani.
z-m-28-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Uchishandisa chimiro ichi, a(5) ne a(8) i chii?
z-m-28-08.s.s1.st.2.after: a(5)=a(4)+a(3)=5+3=8, a(6)=13, a(7)=21, a(8)=34. Zvino sezvo chikonzero chinozivikanwa kubva pachimiro, fungidziro yakaitwa kubva panhamba bedzi inosimbiswa.
z-m-28-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Mushure mekuwana 7 nemutemo wemisiyano, ndakaverenga nhamba zvisirizvo nenzvimbo imwe uye ndakawana 21.
z-m-28-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ndakarebesa mitengo ndichishandisa chimiro chinopatsanura zviitiko nekukwira kwekupedzisira.
z-m-28-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ndakashandisa chimiro kusvika kumutengo wechi5, asi mushure meizvozvo ndakawedzera ne 3 nguva dzose.
z-m-28-08.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ndakaona mitengo sekukwira ne 5 nguva dzose.
z-m-28-08.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga zvose 4 ne 5 (uye ipapo 7 ne 8) zvaigoneka, asi kana chikonzero chekupatsanura nekuti kukwira kwekupedzisira i nhanho 1 kana nhanho 2 chaizikanwa, chakagadzwa kuita chimwe chete. Funga kuti kusarudza imwe chete nekungotarisa pattern munhamba kunosiyana sei nekutsvaga chikonzero uye kusimbisa.
z-m-28-08.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira nzira 4 dzakasiyana dzekukwira nhanho 8 mumakwira 5 chaizvo. Kukwira kwega kwega i nhanho 1 kana nhanho 2, uye kana kurongeka kwemakwira kwakasiyana, i nzira yakasiyana. (nekurongeka w1, w2, w3, w4, w5)
z-m-28-08.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza kuti mangani emakwira 5 anofanira kuva makwira enhanho 2 kuti pundutso ive 8.
z-m-28-08.s.s2.hint.1: Mushure mekusarudza nhamba yemakwira enhanho 2, chinja chete nzvimbo dzinoitika makwira iwayo kuti ugadzire marongero akasiyana.
z-m-28-08.s.s2.ok.c1: Kukwira kwega kwega i nhanho 1 kana nhanho 2.
z-m-28-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota ita kukwira kwega kwega 1 kana 2.
z-m-28-08.s.s2.explain: Kuti pundutso yemakwira 5 ive 8, panofanira kuva nemakwira enhanho 2 matatu chaizvo nemakwira enhanho 1 maviri. Saka nzvimbo mbiri chete apo makwira enhanho 1 anoitika dzinosiyana, uye pane nzira 10 dzekusarudza 2 pa nzvimbo 5.
z-m-28-08.s.s3.prompt: Pane nzira dzakawanda sei pamwe chete dzekukwira nhanho 8 mumakwira 5 chaizvo?
z-m-28-08.s.s3.hint.0: Pazviitiko zvekukwira nhanho 8 mumakwira 4, 5, 6, 7, ne 8, nyora kuti pane makwira mangani enhanho 2.
z-m-28-08.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa kana pundutso yemitengo yakaverengwa nenhamba yemakwira ichienzana ne a(8) yakarebeswa kare.
z-m-28-08.s.s3.r.a: Izvi zvinoverenga chete zviitiko apo nzvimbo yekukwira kwenhanho 2 yakachinjwa nechimwe chete chete.
z-m-28-08.s.s3.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakaverengwa nenzira yekusarudza nzvimbo apo makwira enhanho 1 (kana makwira enhanho 2) anoitika pakati pemakwira 5.
z-m-28-08.s.s3.r.c: Uyu i mutengo wakasiyanisa kurongeka apo wakasarudza nzvimbo dzemakwira enhanho 2. Kusarudza nzvimbo imwechete kwakaverengwa kakawanda.
z-m-28-08.s.s3.r.d: Uyu i mutengo wekusarudza 2 pa 6. Nhamba yemakwira 5 yakaverengwa zvisirizvo se 6.
z-m-28-08.s.s3.explain: Kana ukasarudza pa nzvimbo 5 nzvimbo apo makwira enhanho 1 maviri anoitika, zvose zvakasara i makwira enhanho 2, saka nhamba yenzira dzekusarudza 2 pa nzvimbo 5 i nzira 10. Unogonawo kutarisa nekupatsanura nenhamba yemakwira uye kuwedzera. Makwira 4 anopa nzira 1, makwira 5 anopa nzira 10, makwira 6 anopa nzira 15, makwira 7 anopa nzira 7, uye makwira 8 anopa nzira 1, uye huwandu hwenzira 34 hunoenzana ne a(8)=34.

z-m-28-06.title: Mhinduro yakabuda 0: yakaenda zvisirizvo pamutsara upi?
z-m-28-06.topic: Pakati pematriangle akagadzirwa kubva pamakona eoctagon yakaenzana, nhamba yematriangle asingashandisi divi rimwe reoctagon
z-m-28-06.goal: Ongorora nemuenzaniso mudiki kuti mugumisiro hauna kugoneka, wana mutsara wekutanga wakaenda zvisirizvo uye uugadzirise, uye uwane nhamba chaiyo.
z-m-28-06.material: Makona eoctagon yakaenzana akaverengwa 1, 2, ..., 8 nenzira yekutenderera yeawachi. Kana tikagadzira matriangle ane 3 kubva pazvo semakona, matriangle mangani ane mativi ose matatu asiri divi reoctagon (mativi ose matatu madiagonal eoctagon)? Kona 8 riri padhuze nekona 1, uye mutsara unobatanidza makona akavakidzana idivi reoctagon. Mhinduro yaDoha ndeiyi inotevera.
z-m-28-06.thinking.1: Kuwana mutsara usina kururama mumhinduro inopatsanura kuita nyaya
z-m-28-06.s.s1.prompt: Mhedziso yaDoha i0. Kukanganisa kwekutanga kuri pamutsara upi mumhinduro? Mitsara inoverengwa kubva pa1.
z-m-28-06.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga kuti mativi mangani eoctagon anoshandiswa kana ukasarudza makona 1, 3, ne5, uye uenzanise nemhedziso yaDoha.
z-m-28-06.s.s1.hint.1: Mumutsara 3, kana divi 1-2 rasarudzwa, nyora zvakananga '6 makona asiri mapoinzi maviri ekumagumo,' gadzira triangle neimwe neimwe, uye uverenge kuti ine mativi mangani eoctagon.
z-m-28-06.s.s1.line.0: Pane nzira 56 dzekusarudza 3 kubva pamakona 8, uye mapoinzi matatu akasarudzwa anogadzira triangle nguva dzose.
z-m-28-06.s.s1.line.1: Matriangle anoshandisa mativi 2 eoctagon inyaya dzekusarudza makona matatu akavakidzana (semuenzaniso, makona 1, 2, 3), uye pane 8 ayo.
z-m-28-06.s.s1.line.2: Triangle inoshandisa divi rimwe chete reoctagon inowanikwa nekusarudza divi rimwe (nzira 8) nekusarudza rimwe (1) remakona 6 asiri mapoinzi ekumagumo edivi iroro, saka i8×6=48 nzira.
z-m-28-06.s.s1.line.3: Matriangle anoshandisa divi i8+48=56 nzira, saka matriangle asingashandisi divi i56−56=0 nzira.
z-m-28-06.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 3 ndiwo kukanganisa kwekutanga. Kana divi 1-2 rasarudzwa, pakati pemakona 6 asiri mapoinzi ekumagumo 1 ne2 pane kona 8 (padhuze ne1) nekona 3 (padhuze ne2). Kusarudza chero rimwe reaya kunopa mativi 2, saka haigoni kuiswa mu 'chaizvo 1.' Makona anogoneka i4 chete: 4, 5, 6, ne7, saka i8×4=32 nzira. Mhedziso ye0 inoshamisawo. Izvi zvinokonzerwa nokuti kusarudza makona 1, 3, ne5 kunopa triangle isingashandisi divi.
z-m-28-06.s.s2.prompt: Kuti ugadzirise izvi, gadzira matriangle 3 akasiyana anoshandisa divi rimwe chete reoctagon. Divi rinoshandiswa ndiro mutsara unobatanidza kona p nekona p+1 (kana p i8, kona 8 nekona 1), uye kona yechitatu i kona c.
z-m-28-06.s.s2.hint.0: Makona ari padhuze nedivi p-(p+1) i kona (p−1) nekona (p+2). Nyora zvakananga makona asara mushure mekubvisa maviri aya ne p ne p+1.
z-m-28-06.s.s2.hint.1: Nec yawakasarudza, nyora mativi ose matatu etriangle uye uongorore rimwe nerimwe kana iri divi reoctagon.
z-m-28-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Nhamba dzemakona dzinobva pa1 kusvika pa8.
z-m-28-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota ita p ne c nhamba dzechisikigo kubva pa1 kusvika pa8.
z-m-28-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Divi rimwe chete chete reoctagon rinoshandiswa.
z-m-28-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Nec iyi, divi rimwe chete chete reoctagon harishandiswi. Ongorora kana c iri poinzi rekumagumo edivi kana kona iri padhuze nepoinzi rekumagumo.
z-m-28-06.s.s2.explain: Kana divi 1-2 rasarudzwa, c irimwe remakona 4: 4, 5, 6, ne7. Pane mativi 8, saka 8×4=32 nzira. Matriangle akagadzirwa nemakona matatu akavakidzana (mativi 2) ari 8, saka matriangle anoshandisa divi rimwe kana kupfuura i32+8=40 nzira, uye matriangle asingashandisi divi i56−40=16 nzira.
z-m-28-06.s.s3.prompt: Nekuverenga kwakagadziriswa, matriangle mangani zvose asingashandisi divi (mativi ose matatu madiagonal)?
z-m-28-06.s.s3.hint.0: Patsanura huwandu hwose 56 kuita anoshandisa mativi 2, anoshandisa chaizvo 1, nasingashandisi, uye uarongedze mutebhura.
z-m-28-06.s.s3.hint.1: Pa zvakananga mienzaniso mishoma yematriangle akagadzirwa nemakona matatu asiri padhuze.
z-m-28-06.s.s3.r.a: Uku kukosha kwakaverengwa nekubvisa matriangle anoshandisa mativi 2 chete. Hakuna kubvisa matriangle anoshandisa chaizvo divi 1.
z-m-28-06.s.s3.r.b: Uku kukosha kunobva pakubvisa matriangle anoshandisa chaizvo divi 1 chete. Matriangle anoshandisa mativi 2 anofanira kubviswawo.
z-m-28-06.s.s3.r.c: Wakavimba nemugumisiro wemhinduro yekutanga sezvayakaita. Unochinja kana ukaongorora triangle yakagadzirwa ne1, 3, ne5.
z-m-28-06.s.s3.r.d: Uku kutonga kwakabvisa zvose matriangle anoshandisa mativi 2 nematriangle anoshandisa chaizvo divi 1.
z-m-28-06.s.s3.explain: I56−8−32=16. Idzi ndidzo nyaya dzekusarudza makona matatu asiri padhuze, sa1, 3, ne5. Kuverenga zvakananga nzira dzekusarudza 3 kubva pamapoinzi 8 pasina maviri ari padhuze kunopawo 16.

z-m-28-04.title: Nzira dzokuvara mepu ine nzvimbo shanu: sezvo ruzivo rwuchiwedzerwa, kufungidzira kunochinja
z-m-28-04.topic: Huwandu hwenzira dzokuvara nzvimbo dzakasangana nemavara akasiyana (nzvimbo yepakati nenzvimbo dzakaita sebvudzi)
z-m-28-04.goal: Kana mamiriro avavakidzani anozikanwa nhanho nenhanho, rurama kukosha kwakafungidzirwa, paradzanisa kuva mamiriro kuti uwane kukosha chaizvo, uye wobva waishandisa kumamiriro umo huwandu hwemavara hunochinja.
z-m-28-04.material: Chitsuwa chokufungidzira chakaparadzaniswa kuva nzvimbo shanu A, B, C, D, ne E. A iri pakati, uye B, C, D, ne E dzakatenderedza A. B ne C, C ne D, D ne E, ne E ne B dzinosangana. B ne D hadzisangani, uye C ne E hadzisangani. Kusangana papoinzi rimwe chete hakuverengwi sokusangana. Nzvimbo dzinosangana dzinofanira kuvarwa mavara akasiyana, uye hauna kufanira kushandisa mavara ose.
z-m-28-04.thinking.1: Kutsvaga kunopindirana mamiriro avavakidzani nokuparadzanisa kuva mamiriro
z-m-28-04.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwokuverenga kuti nzvimbo imwe neimwe inogona kuvarwa mavara mangani
z-m-28-04.s.s1.prompt: Nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rwuchiwedzerwa, fungidzira huwandu hwenzira dzokuvara uye urururame.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.hint.0: Siyanisa zvaunogona kutaura neruzivo rwaunoziva izvozvi nezvausati wagona kutarisa.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kana uchivara nzvimbo imwe, verenga kuti nzvimbo dzakasangana nayo dzingani dzatovarwa.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Pane mavara 4: tsvuku, yero, girini, nebhuruu. Kutanga, ruvara rumwe rwakasarudzwa kuna A. A inosangana ne B, C, D, ne E dzose.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: B, C, D, ne E imwe neimwe yakaganhurirwa kumavara mangani?
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Dzinosangana na A, saka B, C, D, ne E hadzigoni kushandisa ruvara rwa A. Saka dzinosarudzwa kubva pamavara 3.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Mamiriro okusangana na A akanga asina kushandiswa.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Izvi zvakashandisa mamiriro okuti nzvimbo dzinosangana na A dzinofanira kuva neruvara rwakasiyana na A.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Izvi zvakaganhurira nzvimbo ina kumavara maviri akasiyana chete. Ruvara rupi zvarwo rwakasiyana narwa A runogona kushandiswa.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Zvinoratidzika kuti rinofungidzira kuti B, C, D, ne E dzose dzine ruvara rumwe chete.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Ngatiti tinovara tichitangira ku B. Ndakafunga nzira 3 dza B, nzira 2 dza C dzakasiyana na B nokuti inosangana na B, uye nzira 2 dza D dzakasiyana na C nokuti inosangana na C. Zvino E inosangana ne D ne B zvose.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Tingafungidzira sei huwandu hwenzira dzokuvara B, C, D, ne E?
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.1.after: 3×2×2×2=24 ndiko kukosha kana ukaona 'E inosangana na D chete.' E inosanganawo na B, saka kukosha chaiko kuri pasi pe 24. Saka kuti uwane huwandu chaizvo, unofanira kuparadzanisa kuva mamiriro nokuti B ne D dzine ruvara rumwe chete here kana mavara akasiyana.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ikukosha kwakaverengwa sokunge E inosangana nenzvimbo yepamberi chete. E inosangana nenzvimbo mbiri.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uku kufungidzira kwakaonera kurambidzwa kunobva pa E ichisangana nevavakidzani vaviri.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wakafungidzira zvishoma zvikuru. Uku kutonga kwokuti nzvimbo imwe neimwe haina mavara anenge okusarudza.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.2.info:
Paradzanisa kuva mamiriro nokuti B ne D dzine ruvara rumwe chete kana mavara akasiyana.
(1) B ne D dzine ruvara rumwe chete: C ne E hadzisangani. Verenga kuti mavara mangani anogona kushandiswa kuna C kuna E rimwe nerimwe.
(2) B ne D dzine mavara akasiyana: C inofanira kudzivirira zvose B ne D, uye E zvakafanana. Verenga kuti mavara mangani anosara kuna C ne E.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Tichisanganisira mavara 4 e A, pane nzira dzingani pamwe chete dzokuvara mepu yose nemavara 4?
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.2.after: (1) B ine nzira 3, D ine nzira 1 nokuti ine ruvara rwakafanana na B, uye C ne E imwe neimwe inosarudzwa kubva pamavara 2 akasiyana na B (na D), saka 3×1×2×2=12 nzira. (2) B ine nzira 3, D ine nzira 2 dzakasiyana na B, uye C ne E imwe neimwe yakagadzikwa neruvara 1 rwakasara, saka 3×2×1×1=6 nzira. Nzira dzokuvara B kusvika E ndi 18, uye kuwanza nemavara 4 e A kunopa nzira 72.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakawedzera kukosha kwemamiriro maviri, nzira 12 nenzira 6, kuti uwane nzira 18, uye wakawanza nemavara 4 e A.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Izvi zvakawanza nzira 4 dza A nokufungidzira kwepakati 24 sezvakaita.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Izvi zvakawanza nzira 4 dza A na 81, isina mamiriro avavakidzani.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Izvi zvakaverenga nzira dzekupenda B kusvika E chete uye hazvina kuwanza ne4 mavara e A.
z-m-28-04.s.s1.reflect: Kutonga kwekutanga (B kusvika E zvinoshandisa mavara 3 chete) kwakamira kusvika kumagumo. Chakachinja kufungidzira kwepakati. 24 yaiva kukosha kwaifungidzira kuti 'pane muvakidzani mumwe chete,' saka kana ruzivo rwekuti E inobata vavakidzani vaviri rwakawedzerwa, rwakagadziriswa nekutonga kuti inofanira kuva diki. Tarisa shure kana kuwana kwakaenda kufungidzira kwakakosha kupfuura kuverenga.
z-m-28-04.s.s2.prompt: Kana tikaderedza mavara kuita 3 (tsvuku, yero, girini), pane nzira dzingani dzekupenda mepu yose? Nyora kukosha nechikonzero.
z-m-28-04.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti mavara mangani asara kuna B kusvika E kana ruvara rwe A rwasarudzwa.
z-m-28-04.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza ruvara rumwe rwe B uye upende C, D, ne E nenzira, uye uongorore kana pane sarudzo dzinoitika.

z-m-28-09.title: Takawana mhinduro dzine x<y<z; kana tikabvisa kurongeka, pane mhinduro dzakawanda sei?
z-m-28-09.topic: Natural numbers nhatu dzakasiyana dzine pundutso 12: mamiriro anogadza kurongeka uye mamiriro asingagadzi
z-m-28-09.goal: Tsvaga mhinduro dzinogutsa mamiriro nenzira yakarongeka, uye utsanangure kuti kugadza kurongeka mumamiriro, nekuribudisa, kunokanganisa sei nhamba yemhinduro.
z-m-28-09.material: Natural numbers dzakasiyana x, y, z dzinogutsa x<y<z ne x+y+z=12. Natural numbers i 1, 2, 3, ... Semuenzaniso, (1, 2, 9) inogutsa mamiriro.
z-m-28-09.thinking.0: Kuvaka mhinduro dzakati wandei dzinogutsa miganhu
z-m-28-09.thinking.1: Kusarudza nzira inowana dzese usina kusiya
z-m-28-09.s.s1.prompt: Gadzira (x, y, z) 5 dzakasiyana dzinogutsa mamiriro.
z-m-28-09.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wagadza x diki zvikuru se 1, nyora kuti y+z i chii, wobva watsvaga mapeya anogutsa y<z.
z-m-28-09.s.s1.hint.1: Rongedza mhinduro dzawakawana patafura uchitanga ne x diki zvikuru, uye utarise kuti hapana dzashaikwa.
z-m-28-09.s.s1.ok.c1: x, y, ne z i natural numbers.
z-m-28-09.s.s1.fail.c1: Ndapota ita x, y, ne z natural numbers dzi 1 kana kupfuura.
z-m-28-09.s.s2.prompt: Nzira yakakodzera zvikuru yekutarisa kuti wakawana dzese usina kusiya i ipi?
z-m-28-09.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora mutengo we y+z kuna x=1, x=2, ne x=3, uye unyore mapeya ane y<z.
z-m-28-09.s.s2.hint.1: Edza kana pane mhinduro kana x i 4, uye usarudze kwekumira.
z-m-28-09.s.s2.o.a: Gadza x se 1, 2, 3, ... uye uongorore mapeya ane y<z.
z-m-28-09.s.s2.r.a: Wakashandisa chokwadi chekuti kana ukagadza chinhu chimwe nenguva uye ukaongorora zvasara, unogona kuziva kuti wasvika papi.
z-m-28-09.s.s2.o.b: Verenga chete mitengo ye x, uchifunga kuti kana x yagadzwa, y ne z dzakagadzwa kuita imwe chete.
z-m-28-09.s.s2.r.b: Kunyangwe kana x i 1 bedzi, pane mapeya akati wandei e y ne z. Wakafungidzira kuti dzakagadzwa kuita imwe chete.
z-m-28-09.s.s2.o.c: Pamhinduro imwe neimwe yakawanikwa, wedzerawo dzakachinjana x, y, z sedzimwe mhinduro itsva uye uidzivereng.
z-m-28-09.s.s2.r.c: Mamiriro x<y<z atogadza kurongeka kuita imwe chete. Dzakachinjana dzinoparadza mamiriro, saka hadzisi mhinduro.
z-m-28-09.s.s2.o.d: Tanga nekugadza z se mutengo mukuru 12 uye uongorore uchideredza x ne y.
z-m-28-09.s.s2.r.d: Kana z i 12, saka x+y=0, saka hapana natural number solution. Hauna kufunga nezverange kana uchitanga nenhamba hombe zvikuru.
z-m-28-09.s.s2.explain: Kana x i 1, saka y+z=11 uye pane mapeya 4 ane y<z; kana x i 2, saka y+z=10 uye pane mapeya 2 ane y≥3; kana x i 3, saka y+z=9 uye pane peya 1 ine y≥4; uye kana x i 4 kana kupfuura, hapana mhinduro. Huwandu i 7.
z-m-28-09.s.s3.prompt: Zvino bvisa mamiriro x<y<z, uye zvinokwana kuti x, y, z i natural numbers dzakasiyana dzine x+y+z=12 ((9, 1, 2) i mhinduro zvakare). Pane mhinduro dzakawanda sei pamwe chete? Nyora mutengo nechikonzero.
z-m-28-09.s.s3.hint.0: Kubva pamhinduro imwe (1, 2, 9) ine x<y<z, nyora mhinduro dzese dzaunogona kugadzira nekuchinjana nzvimbo dzenhamba nhatu.
z-m-28-09.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kana mhinduro dzakachinjana nzvimbo i mhinduro dzakasiyana kune imwe neimwe, uye kana dzichiwirirana nemhinduro dzemamwe mapoka.
z-m-28-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatsanangura kuti boka rimwe renhamba nhatu dzakasiyana rinogona kuiswa mumarongero mangani here?

z-m-28-11.s.s3.r.c: Kutonga uku kwakaverenga nekushanda ties (dzose-dzakafanana 3 + dzose-dzakasiyana 6) nemapoka maviri ekukunda zvakaparadzana.

z-m-28-11.s.s3.r.d: Ties dzakaverengwa zvakarurama, asi rimwe remapoka maviri ekukunda rakaverengwa zvisina kururama uye sum chete ndiyo yakaitwa kuenderana.
z-m-28-11.s.s3.explain: Ties ndi nzira 3 dzedzose-dzakafanana pamwe ne3×2×1=6 nzira dzedzose-dzakasiyana, nzira 9. Kune 'mumwe anokunda,' kuti ndiani pakati pevanhu 3 ndiye anokunda uye zvinoratidzwa nomukundi (mikana 3) zvinopa 3×3=9 nzira, uye 'vaviri vanokunda' zvakare ndi3×3=9 nzira. Sum 9+9+9=27 yakaenzana nehuwandu hwose hwenyaya.

z-m-28-07.title: Kududzira rekodhi rekuti vanhu 22 ne25 vakanyoresa vanowedzera kuita 47
z-m-28-07.topic: Kududzira data inoita sepakapokana pakati pehuwandu hwenhamba dzevakanyoresa mabasa maviri nehuwandu hwevanhu vose
z-m-28-07.goal: Tsanangura kuti nei huwandu hwenhamba dzevakanyoresa hunogona kukura kupfuura huwandu hwevanhu vose, vaka zvinogoneka zvakawanda zvinobvumidzwa nedata, uye utonge kuti ruzivo rumwe rwunowedzera rwaizogadzirisa kukosha kupi.
z-m-28-07.material: Vadzidzi 40 veklabhu vakabvunzwa kunyoresa kumabasa ekuedza. Vadzidzi 22 vakanyoresa kuvhura mvura (kuuraya) uye 25 vakanyoresa kukwira makomo. Mudzidzi mumwe anogona kunyoresa mabasa ose maviri. Mudzidzisi anotarisira akanyora, 'Nhamba yevadzidzi vakanyoresa kuvhura mvura kana kukwira makomo i22+25=47.'
z-m-28-07.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwekuverenga nhamba dzevadzidzi nekupatsanura kuita mapoka
z-m-28-07.s.s1.prompt: Kana ukatarisa rekodhi ye47 pamwe chete nevadzidzi 40, nzira inonyanya kuva nemusoro yekuidudzira ndeipi?
z-m-28-07.s.s1.hint.0: Shanda kuti mudzidzi akanyoresa kuvhura mvura nekukwira makomo zvose akaverengwa kangani mu22+25.
z-m-28-07.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora mutsara mumwe pachimwe nechimwe pazvinoverengwa nevadzidzi 40 nekunyoresa 47.
z-m-28-07.s.s1.o.a: Data yekunyoresa haina kururama. Nevadzidzi 40, 47 hagoni kunge vakanyoresa.
z-m-28-07.s.s1.r.a: Wakasiya mamiriro ekuti mudzidzi mumwe anogona kunyoresa mabasa ose maviri.
z-m-28-07.s.s1.o.b: 47−40=7, saka vadzidzi 7 havana kunyoresa basa rimwe chete.
z-m-28-07.s.s1.r.b: Wakadudzira zvakawandisa sevasina kunyoresa. Huwandu kuva hukuru kupfuura huwandu hwose hunogona kunge huri nokuda kwekunyoresa kaviri.
z-m-28-07.s.s1.o.c: Pane vadzidzi vakanyoresa mabasa ose maviri, saka 47 inhamba yekunyoresa, kwete nhamba yevadzidzi.
z-m-28-07.s.s1.r.c: Wakafunga kuti mudzidzi anogona kunge akaverengwa kaviri ndokududzira data nemamiriro pamwe chete.
z-m-28-07.s.s1.o.d: Nhamba yevadzidzi inogona kunge isiri 40. 22+25 yakarurama, saka pane vadzidzi 47.
z-m-28-07.s.s1.r.d: Wakachinja chikamu chedata (40) kuti uchengete mhedziso yako. Yatopihwa se40.
z-m-28-07.s.s1.explain: Kana mudzidzi akanyoresa kuvhura mvura nekukwira makomo zvose, mudzidzi iyeye anoverengwa kaviri mu22+25. Saka hazvishamisi kuti huwandu hukure kupfuura huwandu hwose. 47 haisi nhamba yevadzidzi asi nhamba yekunyoresa.
z-m-28-07.s.s2.prompt: Fungidzira kuti data yose yakarurama uye mudzidzi mumwe nemumwe wevadzidzi 40 ari mumwe wa: akanyoresa kuvhura mvura chete, kukwira makomo chete, zvose, kana hapana. Gadzira mapeya 3 akasiyana anogoneka enhamba b yevadzidzi vakanyoresa mabasa ose maviri nenhamba n yevadzidzi vasina kunyoresa rimwe.
z-m-28-07.s.s2.hint.0: Patsanura kuita mapoka mana, kuvhura mvura chete, kukwira makomo chete, zvose, uye hapana, uye uratidze nhamba dzevanhu uchishandisa b ne n.
z-m-28-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kana b yevanyoresi 22 vekuvhura mvura vakanyoresa zvose, nyora kuti vadzidzi vangani vakanyoresa kuvhura mvura chete.

z-m-28-07.s.s2.explain: b ne n dzinogutsa n=b−7 ne 7≤b≤22. Semuenzaniso, (7, 0) inyaya umo munhu wese akanyoresa uye vadzidzi 7 vanopindirana, uye (22, 15) inyaya umo vose 22 vanyoresi vekuvhura mvura vakanyoresawo kukwira makomo uye vadzidzi 15 vasina kunyoresa chinhu. Data oga haisarudzi peya imwe chete.

z-m-28-07.s.s3.r.c: Wakarangarira kuti kubvisa vadzidzi vasina kunyoresa kubva pahuwandu hwose 40 kunopa pakarepo nhamba yevadzidzi vakanyoresa.

z-m-28-07.s.s3.o.e: Nhamba yevadzidzi vakanyoresa kuvhura mvura nekukwira makomo zvose
z-m-28-07.s.s3.r.e: Wakarangarira kuti kana uchiziva nhamba yevadzidzi vanopindirana, unogona kubvisa kupindirana kubva pahuwandu.
